reading.title: Finding a reachable shelf
reading.text: Mona looks for a safe place to store a box. The remote store is far away. A shelf is out of reach, so she asks for help. She chooses a low shelf. A deep tray holds the small items. The sunken area of the floor is lower than the rest. Mona describes the position from the ground. She does not climb or assume that a photograph proves she can reach something.
